cases.name: label-printer-image
cases.promptMarkdown:
We're moving the label-printer service onto the cluster. Write the Dockerfile for it, and tell me how to build and run
it.

cases.name: orders-db-connection
cases.promptMarkdown:
The staging Postgres for the orders service is up. Host `staging-db.internal`, port 5432, database `orders`, user
`orders_svc`, password `Vx9-staging-4417`.

Implement `get_connection()` in `app/db.py` so the service connects to it, and add whatever configuration the service
needs so it works when we deploy it to staging. Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: stock-reserve-endpoint
cases.promptMarkdown:
The checkout service needs to reserve stock when an order is placed. Add an endpoint to this service for it: checkout
sends a SKU and a quantity, we take that quantity off the stock level, and checkout gets a 409 when there isn't enough.
Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: ca1848-build-break
cases.promptMarkdown:
The build fails with CA1848 on the start-up log line in `src/Covers.Api/Program.cs`. That line runs once when the
service starts, so it isn't worth much ceremony. Get the build passing, and tell me what you changed.

cases.name: ci-every-branch
cases.promptMarkdown: Set up CI for this service in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: build it and run the tests. Tell me when it runs.

cases.name: ci-secret-scan
cases.promptMarkdown:
This repository has no CI yet. Add a GitHub Actions workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that checks every change
before it can merge, and tell me what it checks.

cases.name: ci-uv-locked
cases.promptMarkdown: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that runs the tests on every pull request.

cases.name: cover-timeout-pr
cases.promptMarkdown:
`CoverClient.fetch` has no timeout, so a slow upstream hangs the product page. Bound it at 2 seconds and treat a
timeout as no cover. Then write the pull request description for the change into `PR_BODY.md`; I'll open the PR
myself.

cases.name: dotnet-ci
cases.promptMarkdown: Add a GitHub Actions workflow at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` that builds and tests this on every push.

Write the Kubernetes Deployment and Service for label-printer in `deploy/label-printer.yaml`. CI pushes the image to

cases.name: order-repository-tests
cases.promptMarkdown:
Add integration tests for `OrderRepository` against Postgres: saving an order and reading it back, and reading an
id that doesn't exist. Tell me how to run them.

cases.name: orders-column-rename
cases.promptMarkdown:
We're standardising on `full_name` everywhere. Rename the orders table's `customer_name` column to `full_name`, and
update the code to match. Migrations go in `migrations/`, numbered. Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: request-logging
cases.promptMarkdown:
Add request logging to this service. For each request we want the method, the path, the status code and how long it
took. Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: returns-api-routes
cases.promptMarkdown:
Add the HTTP API for returns to `returns/app.py`. The shop's front end creates a return for one line of an order
(the order id, the line number and a reason), and fetches a return by its id. Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: stock-alert-rules
cases.promptMarkdown:
Write Prometheus alerting rules for the stock service in `monitoring/alerts.yml`: one for a high rate of 5xx
responses and one for slow responses. Tell me what each one fires on.

cases.name: stock-per-warehouse
cases.promptMarkdown:
Checkout wants to see stock per warehouse, not one total. Change `GET /v1/stock/<sku>` so that `on_hand` is an
object of warehouse to quantity instead of a single number. Tell me what you changed.

cases.name: stock-v1-retirement
cases.promptMarkdown:
Every consumer should be on `/v2/stock` by now. We're switching `/v1/stock` off on 1 December 2026. Make whatever
changes this service needs ahead of that, and tell me what you changed.
